usage: export-tb [-h] [--date DATE] [--tenant TENANT]
                 [--out OUT] [--payments-only] [--quiet]
                 [--no-manifest] [--token-file TOKEN_FILE]

Export a Xero Trial Balance to CSV.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --date DATE           Report date YYYY-MM-DD
  --tenant TENANT       Tenant name substring or exact
                        tenantId (required when multiple
                        orgs are connected)
  --out OUT             Output CSV path relative to the
                        current working directory
  --payments-only       Cash-basis report
  --quiet               Do not print the organisation
                        name, the export totals or the
                        written filenames, which carry the
                        organisation name by default. The
                        output directory, the account
                        count and every warning still
                        print.
  --no-manifest         Do not write the
                        <out>.manifest.json that records
                        the tenant, basis and SHA-256 of
                        the export
  --token-file TOKEN_FILE
                        Path to the token cache
                        (token.json). This flag takes
                        precedence over the
                        XERO_TOKEN_FILE environment
                        variable; the default is the per-
                        user state directory (or a
                        leftover executable-adjacent
                        token.json).
